public_rationale: This sentence is a hedged impression ('seemingly every software product') joined to a value judgment ('without explaining how it'll make anything better'). He set no threshold and named no measure. 'Seemingly' signals that he was describing how the market felt, not making a firm claim that could be counted. It is clear that many products, including Zoom, which he names, were adding AI at the time. But that does not test his real point, which is that the benefits were not explained. Whether vendor statements like Zoom's 'improve productivity' count as explaining anything is a matter of opinion. Grading it either way would mean inventing a standard he did not use.
limitations: Only one example product was checked, and only as context.
